constraint: CHECK (((("consentItemSchemaVersion" = 0) AND ("consentItems" IS NULL)) OR (("consentItemSchemaVersion" = 1) AND ("consentItems" IS NOT NULL) AND valid_form_consent_items("consentItems"))))

triggers.definition: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER "FormVersion_consent_items_projection" AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON public."FormVersion" DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION check_form_consent_items_projection()

CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER "Question_consent_items_projection" AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public."Question" DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION check_form_consent_items_projection()

scope: Local development PostgreSQL only. Existing FormVersion rows, including prior manually classified versions, were checked as schema 0/NULL and hashed without the additive columns; no row was modified and no consent item was invented retroactively.
